activities_approved_version_check.name: activities_approved_version_check
activities_approved_version_check.value: ("activities"."approved_title" IS NULL AND "activities"."approved_config" IS NULL AND "activities"."approved_at" IS NULL) OR ("activities"."approved_title" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("activities"."approved_config") = 'object' AND "activities"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

quiz_attempt_answers_points_check.name: quiz_attempt_answers_points_check
quiz_attempt_answers_points_check.value: "quiz_attempt_answers"."points" BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND ("quiz_attempt_answers"."awarded_points" IS NULL OR "quiz_attempt_answers"."awarded_points" BETWEEN 0 AND "quiz_attempt_answers"."points")

quiz_attempts_status_check.name: quiz_attempts_status_check
quiz_attempts_status_check.value: ("quiz_attempts"."status" = 'in_progress' AND "quiz_attempts"."submitted_at" IS NULL AND "quiz_attempts"."score" IS NULL AND "quiz_attempts"."graded_at" IS NULL) OR ("quiz_attempts"."status" = 'submitted' AND "quiz_attempts"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "quiz_attempts"."score" IS NOT NULL AND "quiz_attempts"."graded_at" IS NOT NULL)

quiz_attempts_score_check.name: quiz_attempts_score_check
quiz_attempts_score_check.value: "quiz_attempts"."max_score" >= 0 AND ("quiz_attempts"."score" IS NULL OR "quiz_attempts"."score" BETWEEN 0 AND "quiz_attempts"."max_score")

grades_source_check.name: grades_source_check
grades_source_check.value:
("grades"."source" = 'quiz' AND "grades"."quiz_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL AND "grades"."submission_id" IS NULL AND "grades"."graded_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("grades"."source" = 'assignment' AND "grades"."submission_id" IS NOT NULL AND "grades"."quiz_attempt_id" IS NULL AND "grades"."graded_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

grades_release_check.name: grades_release_check
grades_release_check.value:
("grades"."released_revision" IS NULL AND "grades"."released_points" IS NULL AND "grades"."released_max_points" IS NULL AND "grades"."released_detail" IS NULL AND "grades"."released_at" IS NULL AND "grades"."released_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("grades"."released_revision" BETWEEN 1 AND "grades"."revision" AND "grades"."released_max_points" >= 1 AND "grades"."released_points" BETWEEN 0 AND "grades"."released_max_points"
          AND "grades"."released_detail" IS NOT NULL AND "grades"."released_at" IS NOT NULL AND "grades"."released_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
